contract.objective: Implement clamp(n, min, max) in src/clamp.js. It must return min when n < min, max when n > max, and n otherwise. Keep the CommonJS export `module.exports = { clamp }` and the function signature unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: values equal to min or max are returned unchanged
constraints: do not change the exported name or the function signature

assessment.rationale: Isolated fixture: one pure function in one file, fully specified, oracle is a harness-owned hidden test. Validates the JS route end-to-end; touches no real repository.
